title: alethia.yaml
description: A project as `alethia apply` reconciles it and `alethia plan` previews it. The file is desired state: apply creates what is missing and changes what differs, and never removes what the file leaves out.

project.description: The project's name. It is unique in the organization, and it is how apply finds a project that already exists.

cloud.description: The cloud account and region the project is built in.

account.description: The cloud account, by the label `alethia connector list` shows. An id is also accepted.

region.description: The cloud region, for example eu-west-1.

version.description: The OpenTofu version to use. Leave it out to take the control plane's default.

environments.description: The project's environments, in order. The first one owns the cluster the others are placed on.

name.description: The environment's name, unique in the project.

placement.description: How the environment is isolated: `dedicated` gets its own cluster, `vcluster` and `namespace` share one. Left out, the first environment is dedicated and every later one is a namespace.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of an environment that shares a cluster. Left out, it is derived from the name.

lifecycle.description: `persistent` (the default) or `ephemeral`. It is set when the environment is created and cannot be changed afterwards.

components.description: The environment's resources, by kind. A kind with one instance (cluster, network, dns, observability, repositories) is a mapping of its fields; a kind with several (databases, caches, ...) is a list of mappings, each with a `name`. `alethia project component kinds` lists the kinds and their fields. A component the file leaves out is unmanaged: it is never removed.

oneOf.description: A kind with one instance: its fields.
A kind with several instances: one entry each.

name.description: The component's name, unique in its kind and environment.

oneOf.description: The kind with every field at its default.

addons.description: The catalog add-ons the environment runs. `alethia addon list` shows the ones an environment has. An add-on the file leaves out is unmanaged: it is never disabled.

id.description: The add-on's id in the catalog, for example external-dns.

version.description: The chart version to pin. Left out, the stored pin is kept; an empty string or null removes the pin.

mode.description: How the add-on is delivered. Left out, the stored mode is kept.

settings.description: The add-on's own settings. Each key is merged over the stored ones; `key: null` resets that key to the add-on's default.

values.description: Helm values that replace the stored Advanced override whole. `null` removes the override. Not with `values_file`.

values_file.description: A Helm values file, relative to alethia.yaml, that replaces the stored Advanced override whole. An empty string removes the override. Not with `values`.
